title: Accounts Receivable Clause: Unit Catch-Up Amount on a Returned Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Bank Draft
content:
**Clause.** For a storage unit catch-up draft under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the returned due date is the agreement's oldest unpaid due date. The unit catch-up amount is the rent charge of the returned due date, which is the contracted monthly rent less the unit class's military discount rate where the military discount is applied, rounded to the cent. The unit catch-up amount is never below zero and is rounded to the cent once.

**Records read.** From the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement: the date the agreement has been delinquent since (its oldest unpaid due date), its contracted monthly rent, whether the military discount is applied, and the military discount rate of its unit class.

**Condition and result.**

| Military discount applied on the agreement | Rent charge of the returned due date |
|---|---|
| Yes | Contracted monthly rent times one minus the unit class's military discount rate, rounded to the cent |
| No | Contracted monthly rent |

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs).**

- Contracted monthly rent $160.00, military discount not applied: unit catch-up amount $160.00.
- Contracted monthly rent $160.00, military discount applied at a rate of 10%: $160.00 times 0.90 is $144.00.
- Contracted monthly rent $133.33, military discount applied at 10%: $133.33 times 0.90 is $119.997, rounded to $120.00.

**Which due date.** An agreement delinquent since 5 March, with the 5 April period also unpaid, has 5 March as its returned due date for this clause (hypothetical dates).
